name: Yatoon Salon Booking – Appointment Calendar for Salons & Spas
author: yatoon

sections.description:
WordPress salon booking built for salons and spas

Yatoon Salon Booking is a mobile-first appointment calendar for salons, spas, nail studios, and beauty businesses. Clients can book online, choose services and staff, receive confirmation emails, and manage appointments through a customer portal.

Free features include:

  • Mobile booking form with service, staff, date, time, and customer details
  • Staff schedule tools and an installable staff portal
  • Customer self-service portal for upcoming appointments
  • Waitlist capture for fully booked days
  • Service menu, catalog, gallery, and booking shortcodes
  • Reminder, notification, and review-request workflows
  • Custom fields, closed dates, client notes, and dashboard reporting

Useful shortcodes:

  • [yatoon_booking] – full booking form
  • [yatoon_service_menu] – visual service menu with Book buttons
  • [yatoon_catalog] – image card grid with filters
  • [yatoon_gallery] – photo carousel for salon work
  • [yatoon_customer_portal] – client self-service portal
  • [yatoon_staff_portal] – staff schedule portal

Square payments, Square sync, advanced automations, loyalty, broadcasts, and other growth tools are available in Yatoon Pro. The free version is designed to work as a standalone salon booking system without requiring an outside booking subscription.

Official downloads, updates, licensing, and support are provided through https://yatoon.com. The plugin code is distributed under the GPLv2 or later.

Square sync and display fixes

  • Fixed multi-service Square bookings omitting catalog-backed Design/Add-on segments.
  • Fixed multi-service availability and appointment length calculations to include add-on duration.
  • Square sync now resolves real customer names, email addresses, and phone numbers independently of email notification settings.
  • Manual and scheduled sync repair legacy “Square Customer” placeholder records.
  • Customer matching now falls back to phone number to reduce duplicate Square customer profiles.

4.2.0

  • Hardened booking verification so email/SMS OTP settings are enforced server-side, not only in the browser.
  • Added an optional strict Cloudflare Turnstile mode for active bot-attack windows.
  • Refined Freemius-facing privacy, external-service, GPL, and Yatoon brand wording.
  • Added Square online payment support for Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Cash App Pay, and Square Gift Card checkout.
  • Added Square payment settings for Application ID, payment mode, enabled payment methods, country code, and wallet setup guidance.
  • Square payments can collect either a deposit or the full appointment amount before the booking is saved and synced.

4.1.6

  • CRITICAL FIX: a service Add-on (multi-select) whose price was configured relative to the base service price could combine with a discounted Main option (e.g. a Fill-in priced below the full service) to produce an incorrect – sometimes negative – total charge. Add-on prices are now stored as the actual flat amount they add, independent of whichever Main option is selected, on save and on Square catalog sync. If you have existing Add-on options, re-open and re-save each one under Services once after updating so its stored price reflects the new, correct calculation (the amount shown on screen will not change, only how it is stored).
  • The booking price preview (cart/review screen) previously showed the highest-priced selected option instead of the combined total when multiple options were selected, which could under-display the price of a real Add-on charge. It now sums correctly and matches what is actually charged.

4.1.5

  • CRITICAL FIX: restored a database schema-version check that had drifted out of sync with the rest of the plugin. On sites that upgraded through earlier versions, this had silently prevented newer tables and columns from being created, including the Clients table, staff time-off requests, and consent/payment/design-upload fields on bookings and services. This is repaired automatically on update; no action needed.
  • Restored Job Queue, Performance, Operations, Commerce, Resources, native Gutenberg blocks, Elementor widget, and Activity Log modules to the Pro package. These shipped in the Free package but were missing from Pro’s startup file.
  • Fixed: multi-service appointments in the Staff Portal detail view were showing the selected option (e.g. “With Gel Polish”) in place of the actual service name (e.g. “Luxe Pedicure”), leaving staff unable to tell what was booked. Each line now shows the service name with its option as a subtitle, its own time and staff, and a correct running total.
  • Security: fixed a Staff Portal access-control gap where the client search endpoint did not confirm an active staff sign-in before returning client records.
  • Hardened Staff Portal PIN sign-in with an additional site-wide throttle against distributed guessing, on top of the existing per-device and per-IP limits.
  • Admin notices no longer echo the plugin’s server file path.
  • Updated description copy to better reflect nail-salon-specific features (design reference photo upload, nail-shape preference).

4.1.3

  • Kept the professional 5-step booking flow and tightened the mobile first-screen spacing.
  • Added instant booking URL support for direct service, staff, and category links.
  • Added manual next-opening search on the date/time step.
  • Restored a today-first date/time experience: selecting staff loads the current selected date instead of auto-jumping to a future opening.
  • Added a same-day slot guard so past times are hidden and empty states clearly reference today.
  • Fixed Brand & Colors saving for Plugin Background, Panel/Card Background, border, and text/color fields.
  • Connected mobile booking edge background to the saved Plugin Background setting instead of hard-coded pink.
  • Slimmed mobile service cards so clients see more services before scrolling.
  • Improved checkout confidence messaging on the review step.
  • Added Pro release smoke checks for versioning, setting persistence, mobile layout, and availability behavior.

4.1.2

  • Added a Loyalty / Rewards points program: clients earn points automatically on paid visits, redeemable for a discount at Staff Portal checkout.
  • Added Marketing Broadcasts: send a one-off email/SMS to a client segment (all, lapsed, by service history, or tag) with live recipient count and batch sending.
  • Updated the bundled Freemius SDK to 2.13.4.

4.1.1

  • Fixed multi-service visits not merging into one calendar card when the underlying booking rows didn’t have a shared group link (older bookings, or edge cases). The calendar now also merges rows that are unmistakably the same visit – same customer, same staff, exact same start time – as a fallback.

4.1.0

  • CRITICAL FIX: bookings submitted through the website’s booking form could silently fail to save due to a missing database column referenced by the booking-save code since 4.0.4. Fixed automatically on update – no manual steps needed.
  • Added an independent admin app shell: a dedicated left nav + top bar replacing the default WordPress admin chrome, plus a fix for WordPress’s native “Screen Options / Help” tabs floating oddly.
  • Staff Portal calendar: multi-service visits now display as one merged card (like Square) instead of separate same-name blocks; checkout/status updates now apply to every service in the visit instead of just the first.
  • Fixed a bug where the Today tab could show the wrong day due to a function-naming collision.
  • Added a configurable idle auto-lock to the Staff Portal for unattended-device security.
  • Added a new visual Automation builder: set up rules like “24 hours after a booking is still Pending, send an SMS reminder” as connected trigger -> action cards instead of scattered settings toggles.
  • Added a live color preview to Brand & Colors so changes to the booking page’s colors are visible instantly.
  • Added mobile card-layout responsiveness to the Bookings admin table and quick-jump staff tabs to the admin Staff Calendar.
  • Polished the customer booking page’s step transitions and button interactions.
  • Consolidated overlapping admin design-token systems for long-term consistency.

4.0.5

  • Fixed the design/photo-upload highlight so it actually appears (with good contrast) across the Bookings admin list, admin Staff Calendar, and every Staff Portal calendar view, including “Today”.
  • Fixed PIN pad double-tap-to-zoom on the Staff Portal login screen.
  • Added a simplified “Month” calendar view to the Staff Portal for staff who only need to see their own schedule.
  • Added a “View details” popup to admin Staff Calendar cards and a manual Duration field to the Staff Portal appointment editor.
  • Fixed Square reschedules (time changes) not syncing back, and added an optional Square webhook for near-real-time sync.

4.0.4

  • Added a design-image filter and gallery viewer to the Bookings admin list so image-backed appointments can be reviewed in batches.
  • Added in-place full-size design image preview to the Staff Portal appointment detail view.
  • Hardened Pro design-reference uploads with attachment tokens, orphan cleanup, and limited image derivative generation.

4.0.3

  • Added a compact search bar under the category tabs on the booking page so customers can quickly find a service by name or description.
  • Fixed Business Logo not saving in Brand & Colors (logo was written to the wrong option key and never appeared on the booking page, portal, or emails).
  • Fixed deleted/renamed service categories lingering forever in the Brand & Colors “Category Order & Names” list.

4.0.2

  • Improved contrast for the Today command card in the owner dashboard.
  • Removed the duplicate horizontal scrollbar from the Staff table.
  • Reworded the customer design-image upload prompt to clearly request a reference photo showing the desired color, shape, or nail art.

4.0.1

  • Rebased the Pro package on the known-working 3.6.0 booking flow.
  • Kept the existing Confirm Booking button and booking submission logic unchanged.
  • Fixed Just me appointments so they skip the group-only Add guests and services screen.
  • Tightened the mobile category tabs and More button spacing so the final tab is less likely to be clipped.
  • Made the customer self-service post-cancel buttons compact on mobile screens.
  • Added a backward-compatible Vagaro API loader for legacy AJAX paths.
  • Preserved Pro Freemius packaging and Square, Vagaro, Google Calendar, and Twilio integrations.

3.6.0

  • Added a Today workspace with next-client, appointment, unpaid, pending, and late indicators.
  • Added Staff, Manager, and Owner permission presets while retaining granular portal permissions.
  • Added staff time-off requests with manager approval or rejection and automatic availability blocking.
  • Added client visit history, allergy, preference, and recent-note context to appointment details.
  • Replaced squeezed mobile multi-staff columns with horizontal employee tabs.
  • Preserved existing appointments, availability rules, staff PINs, shortcodes, and settings.

3.5.0

  • Added a dedicated Yatoon admin shell and improved responsive admin layouts.
  • Refined the staff portal with Day, Week, and Agenda views.
  • Added secure customer design-image uploads for enabled services and design add-ons.
  • Added reusable existing-item selection for service options with shared reference IDs.
  • Improved mobile booking progress, fixed visible encoding artifacts, and preserved 3.4.0 compatibility.

3.4.0

  • Improved: Preserved the 3.3.20-3.3.29 Services admin refinements as the new release baseline.
  • Improved: Added clearer Active/Hidden controls, editable options, compact service cards, and reliable responsive widths.
  • Analytics: Added a privacy-aware five-step activation funnel using Freemius only on sites that already allow tracking.
  • Privacy: Conversion events exclude customer, appointment, payment, and explicit site-domain data.
  • Stability: Free and Pro share the same telemetry and database core, backed by release parity tests.

3.3.29

  • Replaced the Services list status checkbox with a clear Active/Hidden status button so selection and visibility controls are no longer confused.
  • Widened the Edit Service modal, added an explicit close button, and prevented option action controls from being clipped.

3.3.28

  • Made Service Options / Variations editable directly inside the Edit Service modal, including name, duration, price, and type.
  • Added per-option Save and Delete controls so add-ons no longer need to be deleted and recreated for small changes.

3.3.27

  • Reworked the Services admin page into self-contained service rows that show key details without dragging right.
  • Disabled resizable-column behavior for the Services list so old saved column widths cannot squeeze the visible content.

3.3.26

  • Reworked the Services admin list into a compact overview that fits common admin screens without hunting for far-right actions.
  • Added click-row-to-edit behavior so service details, categories, options, and add-ons are managed in the edit modal instead of a wide inline table.

3.3.25

  • Moved Services admin management actions into the top toolbar: select one service, then Edit Selected, Add Add-on, or Delete Selected.
  • Hid the far-right row Actions column from the Services table so important controls no longer require horizontal scrolling.

3.3.24

  • Fixed the Services admin table column initialization so Service Name no longer expands and pushes Duration, Price, Category, Status, and Actions off-screen.
  • Preserved resizable columns while applying practical default widths and a one-time reset of older saved oversized Services table widths.

3.3.23

  • Refined the Services admin table so default columns start narrower while remaining resizable by the user.
  • Reset old saved Services table widths and made service selection update immediately on pointer down.

3.3.22

  • Improved the Services admin table so key actions stay visible without horizontal hunting on desktop screens.
  • Made service row selection more reliable by increasing checkbox hit targets and allowing the checkbox cell to toggle selection.

3.3.21

  • Improved the Services admin option editor with visible Save/Delete actions, Unsaved/Saved feedback, and clearer inline option management.
  • Fixed duplicate horizontal scrollbars on the Services admin table so option editing is easier to use.

3.3.20

  • Fixed mobile option and add-on cards on Android/narrow browsers so long service option names wrap normally instead of collapsing into vertical text.
  • Improved mobile booking width and option-card spacing to reduce empty side gutters while keeping prices and selection circles readable.

3.3.19

  • Stability: Free and Pro now load the same shared core before all business classes.
  • Upgrade safety: UI-only releases no longer rerun the full database schema migration.
  • Testing: Added automated shared-core, schema-upgrade, package parity, and WP-CLI smoke tests.
  • Onboarding: New Square/Vagaro-aware setup wizard with optional demo data, automatic page creation, and direct test booking.
  • Insights: Added a local activation funnel from activation through the first real booking.
  • Trust: New installations stay clean unless sample staff and services are explicitly selected.

3.3.18

  • Improved: Client profiles now surface VIP, upcoming booking, no-show, and unpaid signals directly in the client list.
  • Improved: Square no-show fee statuses are clearer across Staff Portal, admin calendar, and bookings.
  • Improved: Booking payment status labels now include no-show fee charged and waived states for cleaner operations.

3.3.17

  • New: Added a Square-only no-show fee workflow for Staff Portal and admin calendar.
  • New: Staff can open Square, copy the Square booking ID, mark a no-show fee charged in Square, or waive the fee after marking an appointment No Show.
  • Improved: No-show appointments remain visible in operational calendar views so staff can finish the charge/waive decision.

3.3.16

  • Refined: cleaner admin license wording, steadier mobile spacing, stronger button/focus states, and clearer release metadata for Free and Pro packages.
  • Improved: tightened service/category cards and booking controls so the interface feels more polished on phone and desktop.

= 3.3.15 …
sections.faq:
Does this work with Square or Vagaro?

Real-time Square and Vagaro calendar sync is available in Yatoon Pro. The free version supports local availability management through the built-in calendar.

Can clients book for a group?

Yes. Yatoon supports group appointments – your client can book services for themselves and a guest in a single checkout, with separate service and staff selection for each person.

Can I add multiple services to one appointment?

Yes. Clients can add as many services as needed. The booking form shows a running total of time and price, and the calendar finds a start time that fits the full combined duration.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yatoon is designed mobile-first. The booking form, service menu, and photo gallery all work smoothly on phones and tablets.

Does it send confirmation emails?

Yes. Automated confirmation emails go out immediately after booking, with a full appointment summary and a link to manage or reschedule.

Can clients leave a star rating without creating an account?

Yes. After their appointment, clients receive an email with a one-tap star rating link. No login or account required.

How do I display my service photos?

Upload photos to each service (Services > Edit > Gallery Images), then add [yatoon_gallery] to any page. The carousel auto-scrolls and supports swipe on mobile.

Does AI cost money?

WordPress 7.0 provides the AI Client interface, but the site owner pays their chosen AI provider if that provider charges for usage. Yatoon does not store AI API keys or charge for AI usage.

Does Yatoon still work on WordPress 6.9?

Yes. The booking system remains compatible with WordPress 6.9 and older. AI features only appear when the WordPress 7.0 AI Client is available and configured.

What languages is Yatoon available in?

Yatoon is translation-ready and compatible with WPML and Polylang. All strings are localized.
